posts.title: I’ve decided to dig a pond
posts.description: I’ve decided to dig a pond. There is life waiting to be born. But with ponds come liners, and though many claim that any pond is better than no pond, there’s something about a plastic-lined pond that feels deeply disordered–so much so that I’m not certain I agree that any pond is better than none.
